subject: [PATCH 10/11] nfsd: check fi_had_conflict under deleg_lock before hashing a delegation

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 delegation handling code by checking if there was a conflict under the deleg_lock before hashing the delegation. This ensures that a recalled delegation is not granted and then left unrevoked by the laundromat. The fix involves adding an additional check for fi_had_conflict under deleg_lock after taking the lock, which prevents the bug from occurring. This patch addresses a problem introduced in a previous commit (5ea9a7c5fe41) that removed the fi_lock taken in nfsd_break_deleg_cb().
